reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: ML potentials are known to capture many-body interactions and diverse local environments better than EAM, which directly addresses the phase-space overlap problem in high-temperature liquids.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive, specifying a comparative TI study, measurable metrics (phase-space overlap, free energy convergence), and a quantitative falsification criterion (≥30% reduction in mismatch).
reasons.usefulness: This is a highly useful, actionable proposal that directly tackles the core methodological limitation of TOR-TILD for high-entropy alloy liquids, with a well-defined benchmark and boundary conditions.
